affected_subject.reason: BuilderWallet contract and its init()/builderAdmin/sweep() are identified.

trigger_or_action.reason: Any address can call init() (including re-calling) to set itself as builderAdmin.

direct_effect.reason: Attacker gains builderAdmin and sweep() rights, draining ERC20 tokens.

safety_relation_basis.reason: States access control invariant that only builderAdmin/factory should control init and withdrawal authority.

summary: Report identifies the vulnerable init() in BuilderWallet, the unrestricted/re-initializable trigger, the resulting admin takeover and token drain, and the violated access-control invariant.
